symptom: DialogCloseButton moved onto IconButton, which names itself from label; the theme editor still passed aria-label="Close theme editor", which typechecked because JSX accepts undeclared dashed attributes, and IconButton renamed the button to the default "Close". Only the design-workbench ui-smoke noticed.
rule: A component that takes its accessible name from a prop declares aria-label?: never, so a stray aria-label is a type error directly and through every wrapper; when a primitive changes how it is named, grep its callers for the old attribute.
